Source review of frozen .qc-cache/hireops-lessons-2026-10-08-r2/task (input ccf245cd...). task/environment/Dockerfile (sha256 0a75419e...) is byte-identical to the frozen template rules/projects/webdev-task-template/environment/Dockerfile (same sha256; diff empty), so no task-side drift.
Checked against workbook Quality Checks row 15 (A16..D16: 'Agent image is pinned, pre-installs every runtime dependency (no run-time install), and stages the assets.'; Internal Quality Checks sheet row 15 identical text, no extra annotation; no comments/threaded comments in the xlsx) and skill references/quality-checks.md '### 15' verify list:
- Pinned base: Dockerfile:1 'FROM node:22-bookworm-slim' (template tag pin; no --platform). npm pins Dockerfile:9-12 'npm install -g --no-audit --no-fund express@5.1.0 better-sqlite3@12.4.1'. apt line Dockerfile:5-7 (ca-certificates git procps sqlite3) is unpinned, which deterministic-checks.md/workbook check-dockerfiles.py treat as a NOTE only.
- NODE_PATH: Dockerfile:3 'ENV NODE_PATH=/usr/local/lib/node_modules' matches the global install location and test.sh:106/162 'NODE_PATH="/usr/local/lib/node_modules"'.
- Every runtime dependency: the golden's only non-built-in requires are src/db.js:7 require('better-sqlite3') and src/index.js:18 require('express'); others are fs/path/crypto/node:http/node:worker_threads. solution/app/package.json:13-16 pins exactly better-sqlite3 12.4.1 and express 5.1.0. No node_modules or symlinks shipped in the task. solve.sh only copies files (cp -a, line 35) and does no install. Public contract agrees: instruction.md:15 'Server dependencies are already available, so don't install packages'; integration.md:3-4 'Express and better-sqlite3 already available through NODE_PATH; use only those packages and Node built-ins'. Verifier image tests/Dockerfile:16-22 installs the same two pins (row 22/check-runtime-deps-in-both-images agreement).
- Stages assets: Dockerfile:14-15 'COPY instructions/ /instructions/' and 'COPY assets/ /assets/'; Dockerfile:16 'chmod -R a+rX /instructions /assets'; sources exist (environment/instructions/{hireops_rules.md,integration.md}, environment/assets/seed_data.json parses as JSON and is byte-identical to solution/app/src/seed_data.json).
- /app: Dockerfile:17-23 mkdir, git init, commit of only .gitkeep; WORKDIR /app; no COPY/ADD of solution/ or tests/.
- No grade-time network dependency: test.sh runs the copied /app with node directly, no npm install.
Counter-probes: (a) a broken app needing an extra package (e.g. ws) would fail to start at grade time unless it vendored node_modules under /app; that is the builder's fault, consistent with the public 'don't install packages' line, not an image defect. (b) a conforming app using only express/better-sqlite3/built-ins via NODE_PATH resolves in both images; nothing in the brief demands a dependency the image lacks (live updates are achievable with built-in SSE as the golden does at src/index.js:103).
Lessons file (handoffs/LESSONS_FROM_COLDERWATER_2026-10-08.md) checked: items 18-19 (re-review after fixes; Docker golden harness) bear on this row; the Dockerfile is unchanged from template, so no fix-induced drift. Item 19: raw-evidence-index entries (hashes verified, all matching_source_files match the frozen bytes) ran the scripted golden in the verifier image hireops-verifier:20261002-permission-repair, which carries the same express/better-sqlite3 pins, giving indirect evidence the pinned packages install and load; no agent-image build log is indexed for this round, so the agent image build itself is NOT EXERCISED. That missing build is a template-identical image and not a required measurement for this source row; it is not upgraded into a measured claim.
